The ¹H NMR shows only methyl singlets (12 H total) and the ¹³C NMR shows 7 distinct carbons: a carbonyl (~161 ppm) and two sp² carbons (~144 and 130 ppm) plus four methyl carbons. This suggests a C₇H₁₂O (or O₂) type structure with a carbonyl and a fully substituted C=C. Obtaining the mass spectrum will give the exact molecular ion and confirm the formula.</thought>
